card.name: Cal Poly eggs
card.origin: Based in San Luis Obispo, California
card.description: Cook gently, season well. Eggs can turn a piece of toast into breakfast and a pot of leftovers into dinner.

meet_the_maker.name: Cal Poly
meet_the_maker.story: At Cal Poly, food is something you learn by making. Students work on products from cheese and chocolate to jam and barbecue sauce. This is San Luis Obispo’s hands-on food tradition: practical skills, real ingredients, and something you can actually bring home for dinner.
